what_the_probe_found_instead.headline: The two mugs that cost a sub-goal are UPSIDE DOWN, not tipped. Final upright_cos is -1.000 on seeds 5 and 6, and 0.001 on seed 2, against a 0.906 bar.
what_the_probe_found_instead.why_that_matters: The recorded explanation -- hold_above_base()'s own docstring, 'dragging it from the top rim tipped it over' -- predicts a mug lying on its side, cos ~= 0. That is seed 2, which is 359 mm from its mat and was never going to score. It does NOT predict cos = -1.000, and -1.000 is what the two seeds that reached the mat show. The remedy in the tree was aimed at a failure that is not the one costing sub-goals, which is why turning it on does not help.

when_it_happens_measured.source: evidence/mug_inversion.json, per-move upright_cos through the shunt
when_it_happens_measured.seed_2: cos 0.995 at mug_left2_drag -> 0.519 at mug_left2_release -> 0.000 at mug_left2_clear. The RELEASE knocks it over, and the same move throws it from 273 mm to 358 mm -- backwards, away from the mat.
when_it_happens_measured.seed_5: cos 0.982 at mug_left2_lift -> 0.712 at mug_left2_drag -> 0.521 at mug_left3_drag -> 0.001 at mug_left3_clear. A progressive topple across successive drags.
when_it_happens_measured.the_structural_defect: _shunt has no notion of which way up the mug is. Once it is over, the remaining grasp-drag-release cycles keep gripping and dragging a lying mug and roll it, which is how seeds 5 and 6 arrive at cos = -1.000: the shunt delivers the mug to its mat successfully and upside down. Seed 6 finishes 23.9 mm from target -- less than half the tolerance -- and scores nothing.

what_the_probe_found_instead.why_this_kills_the_grip_height_theory_di: On seed 2 the topple happens at a RELEASE, when the jaws are opening and no grip height is being applied at all. Grip height cannot explain a topple that happens after the grip ends.

not_claimed: No cause for the release-topple is claimed. The probe measures WHEN the mug goes over and WHICH move was commanded; it does not establish why that release knocks it.
